cards.title: copy_model_version() doesn't span accounts
items: It copies within one registry the client is connected to — same account, shared metastore
A cross-cloud move has two accounts, two metastores, no shared registry to call it against
The unavoidable pattern is download, re-log, and register — model versions are artifacts, not metadata

cards.title: A model without a signature will not register
items: Unity Catalog requires a model signature; a legacy model logged without one fails outright
This surfaces as a batch of failures late, at cutover, unless found during discovery first
The proper fix is re-logging with a signature inferred from a sample input, scheduled per model

cards.title: Version numbers never match
items: Target versions are assigned in registration order starting at 1 — source version 47 will not be 47
Stages don't exist in Unity Catalog; translate Production/Staging to champion/challenger aliases
Pin every consumer to an alias, not a version number — that's what stops this from recurring
